candidates.name: dummy_stratified
candidates.label: Dummy Classifier (Stratified)
candidates.description: Randomly predicts churn matching the empirical training class distribution.

candidates.name: prior_baseline
candidates.label: Prior baseline
candidates.description: Predicts the training churn rate for every customer. Any useful model must beat it.

candidates.name: logistic_regression
candidates.label: Logistic regression
candidates.description: Regularised linear model on standardised numeric and one-hot categorical features.

candidates.name: logistic_regression_balanced
candidates.label: Logistic regression (class-weighted)
candidates.description: Same model with balanced class weights. Kept for comparison only: reweighting inflates predicted probabilities, and Attritex reports probabilities to users.

candidates.name: hist_gradient_boosting
candidates.label: Histogram gradient boosting
candidates.description: Shallow boosted trees with L2 regularisation and a conservative learning rate.

candidates.name: random_forest
candidates.label: Random forest
candidates.description: Bagged decision trees with a minimum leaf size to limit overfitting.

selection.explanation: Logistic regression was selected because it is the simplest eligible model whose mean cross-validated PR-AUC is within one standard error of the best (Random forest, 0.663 ± 0.010).

out_of_fold.description: Selected model, out-of-fold predictions on the training split.
